The 2024 United States Senate election in Utah will be held on November 5, 2024. The incumbent senator from Utah, currently serving in the Senate, is Mike Lee, a Republican who has been in office since 2011.

As of now, it is unclear if Mike Lee will seek re-election in 2024. If he decides to run again, he is expected to face challenges from Democratic and potentially other third-party candidates. If he chooses not to run, the race for the Utah Senate seat could be more competitive.

Utah is a traditionally conservative state, so the Republican candidate is likely to have an advantage in the election. However, with changing demographics and political trends, the Democratic candidate could also have a chance at winning the seat.

Overall, the 2024 United States Senate election in Utah is expected to be closely watched and could have significant implications for the balance of power in the Senate.
